about: The recording each card plays (`file`, in web/src/ipa/sounds/, named by a digest of its bytes) and the version of it chosen (README, "Third round"); per file its Commons source, author, licence, how it was changed, size and length. Ogg Opus, as the app's pronunciations.
codec: Ogg Opus, libsndfile compression 0.8, mono 48 kHz
